         <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:5624"><lb edRef="inst:4423" n="2b2"/> rab tu gnas <lb edRef="inst:4423" n="2b3"/> pa'i rgyud</rs> <note type="editorial" resp="PH">The identification as the Pratiṣṭhāvidhi is tentative.</note> dang <rs type="person" ref="db:5625" ana="corpusmd:named_reference">slob dpon kun dga' snying po </rs> las stsogs pas mdzad pa'i bstan bcos rnams <app><lem wit="inst:4428">gcig</lem> <rdg wit="inst:4428">gcig</rdg> <rdg wit="inst:4423">cig</rdg></app> na'ang <app><lem wit="inst:4428">ma rdzogs</lem> <rdg wit="inst:4428">ma rdzogs</rdg> <rdg wit="inst:4423">rdzogs</rdg></app> shing <app><lem wit="inst:4428">gzhung</lem> <rdg wit="inst:4428">gzhung</rdg><rdg wit="inst:4423">bzhung</rdg></app> mang du <app><lem wit="inst:4428">'thor</lem> <rdg wit="inst:4423">mthor</rdg> <rdg wit="inst:4428">'thor</rdg></app> ba'i phyir | <lb edRef="inst:4428" n="1b4"/> de dag cig tu lag tu blang pa ma <lb edRef="inst:4423" n="2b4"/> 'ongs pa'i skye bo blo chung pa rnams la phan pa'i phyir | <rs type="person" ref="db:3784" ana="corpusmd:named_reference"><app><lem wit="inst:4423">shag kya'i dge slong</lem> <rdg wit="inst:4423">shag kya'i dge bslong</rdg> <rdg wit="inst:4428">sha°pa'i dge slong</rdg></app> rin chen bzang po</rs>s nye bar sbyar <app><lem wit="inst:4423">ba'o</lem> <rdg wit="inst:4423">ba'o</rdg> <rdg wit="inst:4428">ba</rdg></app> || rdzogs s+h+yo ||
